## Track B2B Company Hiring Velocity, Salaries & Tech Stack from Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby
**Powered by StoreIntel Labs on Apify:** [Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby ATS Jobs Scraper: Salaries & B2B Tech Stack Signals](https://apify.com/storeintel/greenhouse-lever-ashby-jobs-scraper)

Automatically scrape open roles across Greenhouse, Lever, and AshbyHQ job boards, parse salary ranges, and detect 80+ enterprise SaaS/cloud tools (Snowflake, AWS, Kubernetes, Salesforce, HubSpot, Datadog) mentioned in job descriptions.

### Quick Setup (30 seconds)
1. Get your free Apify API token at `https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations`.
2. Open the **Run StoreIntel Apify Actor** node and paste your token in the `Authorization` header (`Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`).
3. Customize the JSON input body or connect it to your Google Sheet / Webhook trigger.

### Pre-Configured Apify Task Templates
- [Greenhouse Job Board, Salaries & Tech Stack Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/greenhouse-job-board-salaries-tech-stack-scraper)
- [Ashby & Lever Startup Jobs & Hiring Signals Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/ashby-lever-startup-jobs-hiring-signals-scraper)
- [B2B Company Tech Stack & Hiring Velocity Detector](https://apify.com/storeintel/b2b-company-tech-stack-hiring-velocity-detector)
